prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
Here is the strange part of the new AI race: the phone is still at the center, but many companies are designing around it.

Google says Gemini Intelligence for Android will begin on selected Pixel and Samsung phones. It will later reach watches, cars, glasses, and laptops in 2026. Google also describes Agent Mode for desktop. It is experimental and designed to handle complex tasks with little help.

So phones and computers are not being abandoned. They are becoming starting points for assistants that can work in other places.

The clearest clues appear when people do not want to look down. Google says Android XR glasses could help with messages, appointments, directions, and live translation. These glasses are still being developed. Pixel Buds 2a offer hands-free access to Gemini. Google’s translation beta can send translated speech through headphones in more than 70 languages and 2,000 language pairs.

The move also reaches larger spaces. Google says Android Auto supports about 250 million cars, and it plans to bring Gemini to cars. Apple’s CarPlay Ultra can place iPhone and car information across the vehicle’s screens. Drivers can use Siri, onscreen controls, or physical buttons.

At home, Google’s Gemini for Home is designed for speakers, cameras, doorbells, and the Google Home app.

Taken together, these announcements do not prove that phones are going away. They show something more careful: digital access is spreading to the ear, the wrist, the car, and the home.

【Point One】
The important change is not a race to find one new phone. It is a move toward the best place for each task. Headphones fit listening. Glasses fit quick visual help. A car can use its own screens and physical controls. A home can answer through speakers, cameras, and doorbells. The smartphone may remain important, while some moments no longer need its screen.

【Point Two】
This is not one smooth move. Amazon reports 600 million active Alexa endpoints, but endpoints are not people. It also reports that customers are talking to Alexa more and completing purchases more often. Tens of millions joined Alexa+ early access. Meta reports millions of glasses sold. Meanwhile, Agent Mode is experimental, XR glasses are a preview, and Gemini for cars is planned. Some pieces have reach; others are still being built.

point_one.reasoning: 本文の内容を単に列挙し直すのではなく、「タスクごとに最適な接点を選ぶ」という観点で整理し、スマートフォンの画面を見なくてよい場面が増えるという具体的な意味を示している。Full Storyの結論と関連はするが、用途別インターフェースという解釈を加えているため、新しい価値がある。

point_two.reasoning: Alexaの600 million endpointsや利用増加、Metaの販売実績など、Full Storyにない普及データを加えたうえで、実験段階・プレビュー・計画段階を区別している。したがって、発表や数字を一律に実用化の証拠と受け取るべきではなく、サービスごとに成熟度が異なるという具体的な理解を与えている。
